visualRisks.description: Water and road colors are similar, which might cause confusion.
visualRisks.details: The water color (#143950) is very close to the road color (#667b8a). This similarity could lead to players mistaking roads for water or vice versa.

visualRisks.description: House and dock colors are similar, which might cause confusion.
visualRisks.details: The house color (#aa5149) is close to the dock color (#98734e). This similarity could lead to players mistaking docks for houses or vice versa.

navigationRisks.description: Route path includes a sudden vertical drop.
navigationRisks.details: The route path has a significant vertical change between points 105 and 106, which might be disorienting for players navigating the district.

navigationRisks.description: Some parts of the route are not visible in the grid view.
navigationRisks.details: Points like 76, 88, and 94 are far from the starting point (15) and may require a zoomed-out view to see them. This could make navigation challenging for players.
